from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment, ruling, or notice document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) identified by the court for this case")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
